verdict.rationale: Zapier is a SaaS automation platform with AI features (Copilot, AI troubleshooting, MCP), so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an AI-training opt-out or a data-use policy. SOC 2 certification, governed connections and workspace controls are adjacent security controls and do not address model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
